description: A field (section 3) whose name begins with x- is an extension; OBI documents MAY include extensions in any OBI-defined object. An extension never changes the meaning of a core field; its own meaning, if any, is defined outside this specification.
notes: A document carrying x- fields means what the same document without them means, so the positives conform; a member beginning X- is not an extension, so the negative violates OBI-02. The scenarios observe that an extension changes no core field's meaning: an operation's identifiers and a binding's operation (5.1-names.json), a value contract (5.2-value-contracts.json), a kinds constraint (6-kinds.json), and the version a text declares (10-conformance.json).

tests.description: document with x- extension at the root level
document with x- extensions on operation, binding, and source
an x- member named like a core field (x-operations) is an extension, so the document stays conformant

x-operations.spurious: should be ignored as extension, not interpreted as the operations map

tests.description: x- extension nested deeply inside an operation
a member beginning X- is not an extension: names compare exactly, so it is a field the operation's table does not list (section 5)
